before.content:
- `ji-ai-api`: `ModelRef`, immutable `Message`/`Content`, `Usage`, `ModelRequest`, `ModelResponse`, `ModelStreamEvent`, `ModelProvider`, JI cancellation token/source, `ToolSchema`, Provider Profile/model catalog, credential reference/resolver/material, and structured sensitive/redaction types.
- `ji-agent-api`: `AgentRuntimeBuilder`, `AgentRuntime`, `AgentSession`, `AgentRun`, `AgentEvent`, `SessionOptions`, synchronous `ToolDefinition`, `RuntimeConfiguration`.
- `ji-session-api`: revision-CAS `SessionRepository`, immutable `SessionSnapshot`, and Stage 2's versioned Pi-compatible `SessionDocument`/`SessionCodec` contracts plus shared Repository TCK. The document mutation log owns Entry, LaneRecord, Lane and fact sequence; adapter projections do not become a second fact source.
- `ji-security-api`: non-serializable secret/master-key values, external key source and credential/OAuth ports.
- `ji-extension-api`: capability-based `WorkspaceProvider`, versioned/cancellable `PermissionDecider`, `ToolExecutionPolicy`, ordered `ToolInterceptor`, fail-closed `ToolRetryContract`, stable resource/source/revision/scope identities, `PromptContributor`, `ContextSource`, `SkillSource`, strict prompt renderer/assembler, data-only `Skill`, and hash-bound `ProjectTrustStore` contracts.
- `ji-artifact-api`: SHA-256 identity, full scope/reference DTO、direct/resumable commands、Range/ETag result、quota/retention limits、validation report 和 `ArtifactStore` port；known failure 由 `ArtifactErrors` 生成版本化 `JiException/JiError`。

- `ji-ai-api`: `ModelRef`, immutable `Message`/`Content`, `Usage`, `ModelRequest`, `ModelResponse`, `ModelStreamEvent`, `ModelProvider`, JI cancellation token/source, `ToolSchema`, Provider Profile/model catalog, credential reference/resolver/material, and structured sensitive/redaction types.

- `ji-session-api`: revision-CAS `SessionRepository`, immutable `SessionSnapshot`, and Stage 2's versioned Pi-compatible `SessionDocument`/`SessionCodec` contracts plus shared Repository TCK. Stage 5 extends `SessionSnapshot` with the canonical pending Permission request projection (identity/revision/tool/arguments/workspace/risk/status) and deliberately updates the sole direct fixture caller instead of retaining a compatibility constructor. The document mutation log owns Entry, LaneRecord, Lane and fact sequence; adapter projections do not become a second fact source.

- `ji-extension-api`: capability-based `WorkspaceProvider`, versioned/cancellable `PermissionDecider`, `ToolExecutionPolicy`, ordered `ToolInterceptor`, fail-closed `ToolRetryContract`, stable resource/source/revision/scope identities, `PromptContributor`, `ContextSource`, `SkillSource`, strict prompt renderer/assembler, data-only `Skill`, and hash-bound `ProjectTrustStore` contracts.
- `ji-artifact-api`: SHA-256 identity, full scope/reference DTO、direct/resumable commands、Range/ETag result、quota/retention limits、validation report 和 `ArtifactStore` port；known failure 由 `ArtifactErrors` 生成版本化 `JiException/JiError`。
